gmailGuide.title: How to create a Gmail App Password
gmailGuide.step1: Open your Google Account security settings.
gmailGuide.step2: Turn on 2-Step Verification if it is not already enabled.
gmailGuide.step3: Open App Passwords (search for "App passwords" in Google Account).
gmailGuide.step4: Create an App Password for CheckStation (or Mail / Other).
gmailGuide.step6: Paste it into CheckStation as the App password.
gmailGuide.step7: Save the sender, then send a test email.
gmailGuide.workspaceNote: App Passwords may not be available for some Google Workspace or security-managed accounts. If App Passwords are unavailable, use Custom SMTP with another mailbox for now.

microsoftGuide.title: How to connect Outlook / Microsoft 365
microsoftGuide.intro: CheckStation uses Authenticated SMTP (SMTP AUTH) for this provider. Microsoft OAuth is not available yet.
microsoftGuide.businessSubtitle: Using Microsoft 365 for work or business
microsoftGuide.businessIntro: This is the main supported use case. An administrator can enable Authenticated SMTP for the mailbox in Microsoft 365 Admin Center:
microsoftGuide.step5: Enable Authenticated SMTP for the mailbox.
microsoftGuide.step6: In CheckStation, enter the Microsoft email and allowed password/app password.
microsoftGuide.step7: Save the sender, then send a test email.
microsoftGuide.personalNote: Microsoft increasingly requires Modern Authentication / OAuth for personal Outlook accounts. CheckStation does not yet support Microsoft OAuth, so personal Outlook/Hotmail accounts may not be able to use this provider. An app password does not guarantee compatibility if SMTP AUTH is unavailable.

yahooGuide.title: How to create a Yahoo App Password
yahooGuide.step2: Find External connections (or Generate app password).
yahooGuide.step4: Enter a name such as CheckStation.
yahooGuide.step7: Paste it into CheckStation as the App password.
yahooGuide.step8: Save the sender, then send a test email.
yahooGuide.unavailableNote: Yahoo may temporarily prevent App Password creation for some accounts. If the option is unavailable, check your Yahoo Account Security settings and try again later.
